summary: Iteration 78 - Server-side Pagination + Filters + Search for Admin User List: All 30 backend tests PASSED (100%). context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 78 validated server-side pagination for admin user list. Key behaviors: (1) GET /api/admin/users without params returns RAW LIST (up to 1000 users, newest first) - critical for backward compat with GroupsPanel, ReminderPanel etc. (2) GET /api/admin/users?page=1&limit=50 returns {users:[], total, page, limit, pages}. (3) Search is case-insensitive across name, email, department, location, profession. (4) Filters: role, department, location, status (active excludes inactive, inactive shows only inactive). (5) GET /api/admin/users/filters returns distinct sorted values for filter dropdowns. (6) Frontend shows 'X Nutzer · Seite Y/Z' format, pagination bar appears when pages>1, prev disabled on page 1, debounced search (250ms). (7) GroupsPanel uses allUsers (full list without pagination) for member selection. Regression: All iteration 77 features (force-logout, SMTP, DNS check) still work.
